description: Prepare a native Cloudflare Stream video upload for a writable page of this job (rollout-gated; fails closed with no legacy fallback). Returns a ONE-TIME direct TUS upload grant exactly once per idempotency key: the caller must transfer the file bytes itself with a TUS client (pinned tus-js-client 4.3.1) against uploadUrl — this tool NEVER carries file bytes, and the upload URL is never persisted or replayed. durationSeconds is REQUIRED (it sizes the provider storage reservation). A duplicate key returns the non-secret receipt with recovery guidance (cancel, then re-prepare under a NEW key).
name: opentrain_job_instructions_video_prepare
